actions.description: Start the stepper rotation by sending the upstream XL+ command
actions.name: start_rotation

outputs.description: True once the XL+ command was sent
outputs.name: started

actions.description: Stop the stepper by sending the upstream XS stop command
actions.name: stop_rotation

outputs.description: True once the XS command was sent
outputs.name: stopped

facts.text: The script toggles a Phytron stepper motor on the press of a button
The serial line is /dev/ttyUSB0 at 9600 baud, no parity, eight data bits and one stop bit
A request is framed as STX (0x02), the address byte '0', the ASCII command and ETX (0x03)
A reply is the bytes between STX (0x02) and ETX (0x03)
The script sends XS once when it starts
The script stops the motor with XS, waits one second, then sends X0-
The script starts the motor with XL+ and marks it as rotating
The button that toggles the rotation is wired to GPIO 2
The README points to the Phytron PhyLogic manual for the serial commands

safe_state.description: stepper stopped (XS sent to the controller)
